name: Wikivoyage (English)
use: Which places are travel destinations, the travel hierarchy, guide text evidence, listed sights, first-sentence descriptions

name: Wikidata
use: Stable identity (QID), aliases, country, population, area, sitelink counts; the worldwide layer of notable features (parks, ranges, volcanoes, beaches, ski areas, reefs, heritage sites)
access: Wikidata Query Service, one query per class or per 150 items, cached
cost: free; 60 s query limit, one query at a time

name: CHELSA V2.1 climatologies 1981–2010
use: Monthly mean daily maximum and minimum temperature and precipitation at 30 arc-seconds, sampled where people stay and on the highest ground of each destination
licence: CC0 1.0 (per chelsa-climate.org; the files carry no licence attribute)
access: 36 NetCDF files, about 6 GB, downloaded once

name: ETOPO 2022 (60 arc-second surface)
use: Elevation where people stay, the highest ground within a destination, relief, the land/sea mask
attribution: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, 2022

name: NOAA OISST v2.1 monthly long-term mean 1991–2020
use: Sea-surface temperature of the nearest sea, for swimming and diving seasons

name: OurAirports
use: Airports with scheduled service and an IATA code, for measured distance to the nearest airport and hub

name: World Bank World Development Indicators
use: Household-consumption price level by country (US = 1), the basis of the cost estimate

name: U.S. Department of State travel advisories
use: Country advisory level with its date; a fresh do-not-travel level removes a destination, the level below it becomes a caution on the card

name: Sidequest editorial catalog
use: 234 curated destinations: the editorial rows of the atlas and the labels every estimator is fitted to and checked against

name: Natural Earth 1:10m
use: Landmass identity, country, subunit and first-level boundaries, physical and marine regions

name: GMBA Mountain Inventory v2.0
attribution: Snethlage et al. 2022, Sci Data, doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01256-y; GMBA Mountain Inventory v2, doi:10.48601/earthenv-t9k2-1407 (changed: matched to destinations)

name: UK FCDO foreign travel advice
attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

name: Government of Canada travel advice
attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada.

name: World Bank WDI exchange rates and CPI
use: Converting dated guide prices to constant US dollars
attribution: World Bank, WDI (source: IMF IFS), CC BY 4.0

name: GBIF occurrence data (CC0 and CC BY records only)
use: Which large mammals, birds and marine megafauna are documented in a 1° cell since 2000
licence: Per record: CC0 1.0 or CC BY 4.0
attribution: Credit publishers; cite a GBIF derived-dataset DOI (dataset list in .atlas-cache/work/wildlife-datasets.json; DOI not yet minted, needs an account)
access: occurrence facet API, cached per cell

name: Chen et al. NPP-VIIRS-like night lights 2023
use: Modelled night-sky brightness (a model on measured radiance)
licence: CC0 1.0 as declared by the depositors; upstream VIIRS rights not confirmed
attribution: Chen et al. 2021, ESSD 13(3):889–906; doi:10.7910/DVN/YGIVCD; underlying VIIRS DNB

name: CHELSA V2.1 clt and sfcWind normals
attribution: Karger et al. 2017, Sci Data 4:170122; doi:10.16904/envidat.228

name: WAVERYS monthly climatology (Copernicus Marine)
use: Monthly significant wave height at the coast
licence: Copernicus Marine Service licence (free; derivative works for any purpose)
attribution: Generated using E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information; https://doi.org/10.48670/moi-00022

name: OpenSkiData / OpenSkiMap
use: Operating lift-served ski areas; kept as its own ODbL file and joined in memory at run time
attribution: Data from OpenSkiData / OpenSkiMap.org, © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), Skimap.org, Who's On First, © Mapterhorn
access: bulk download, at most once a day
